details: A dependency-confusion stub in the @cloudplatform-single-spa scope mimicking an internal enterprise namespace, using the high-magnitude version 99.99.99 to hijack dependency resolution. The ~8KB package carries a postinstall lifecycle hook (scripts/postinstall.js) that contacts the out-of-band command-and-control domain oob[.]moika[.]tech on install. The package has since been removed from the registry.
